exhibits.title: Inspect receipt verification software
exhibits.summary: Explore the source for receipt construction and verification, then inspect its tests and contracts. The research question is how a verifier records the evidence available for a proposed action.
exhibits.limitations: This is a source-only exhibit. Runtime replay and independent verification are UNKNOWN. Signature validity depends on the key binding and does not establish that a claim is true or that an action is authorized.

exhibits.title: Compare formal mathematics with executable source
exhibits.summary: Read the formal statements in lutar-lean beside the executable formula library in szl-formulas. Inspect their hypotheses and implementation contracts before proposing a correspondence between a theorem and a callable.
exhibits.limitations: This is a source-only comparison. Proof-to-implementation correspondence and fresh proof or numerical replay are UNKNOWN. Lambda uniqueness remains Conjecture 1; the eight locked formula IDs do not certify every implementation.

exhibits.title: Inspect proposal-only Forge and ReceiptAgent
exhibits.summary: Explore the Forge fine-tuning tooling and the ReceiptAgent repository as a proposal-only research workflow. Forge uses QLoRA on an open base; a model proposal must be evaluated by a separate governed decision layer.
exhibits.limitations: This is a source-only exhibit. Inference, held-out evaluation and independent replay are UNKNOWN here. Model output grants no tool execution or authorization. A GGUF derivative requires its own conversion and equivalence evidence; listed files do not establish a qualified release.
